turns.text: Hi, I'm Owen's teacher. Thanks for coming in.
Why did nobody call me before the zero went in?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
My schedule isn't the issue. Who decided on the zero, and why did I find out from Owen's phone?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
I'm not here to be graded on my manners. Answer the question: who decided on the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
We're not on the same side, Hale. Show me what you have on Owen's essay.
